text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's student council<n>business has
been particularly<n>demanding today. Seeing that
she's<n>starting to flag, I encourage her to<n>take a
break.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I doubt I am half as tired as you think,<n>but I see
your point. There are plenty<n>more meetings to
attend come<n>afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perhaps forty winks would helpsteady me for the task ahead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Where am I? I could have sworn I<n>was in the
infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, there are some people over there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I've seen them<n>somewhere
before... Wait, could they<n>be... the Three
Goddesses?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've heard they appear in dreams to<n>grant the
dreamer's wishes, but I<n>thought it was a frivolous
rumor...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses seem to hear<n>Symboli
Rudolf's voice. They turn<n>toward her and
approach slowly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I need no such assistance. I<n>will seize my
dreams myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My path is my own. I require no aid to<n>walk it, be it
from goddesses or<n>anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses smile serenely.<n>A bright
light fills the surroundings...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As I thought... It was just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel somehow lighter. Taking a<n>break was a
wise choice, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf comes back at full<n>strength and
throws herself into the<n>afternoon's work. Her nap
seems to<n>have paid dividends.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses nod sagely. A<n>bright light
fills the surroundings...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no time like the present.<n>The
afternoon's work awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf casts a glance out of<n>the window
to find that it's already<n>dark.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It can't be... Did I oversleep? How<n>embarrassing...
